CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.
   C. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)

   B. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
